purpose: Keep typography quiet, legible and role-based so visual emphasis never substitutes for explanation.

owns: running-head, folio, code and evidence-label treatment

principles: Typography reveals structure without becoming a separate illustration.
A paragraph begins at the normal body size; decorative drop caps and oversized initial letters are prohibited.
Korean and Latin text share a compatible visual weight and baseline rhythm.
Bold, color and uppercase are supporting signals and never the sole carriers of meaning.
Long-form reading uses stable line length, leading and paragraph spacing across chapters.

display.constraint: Use sentence case; do not set Korean titles in spaced all-caps styling.

body.constraint: Prefer regular weight; use semibold only for short inline emphasis.

utility.constraint: Do not use utility type for narrative paragraphs.

paragraphSystem.openingParagraph: normal body size and weight; no enlarged first character
paragraphSystem.firstLineIndent: none for prototype; use spacing consistently instead
paragraphSystem.columnUse: two columns only for continuous essay sections; single column for traces and evidence review

emphasisRules: Use heading hierarchy before bold or color.
Limit bold emphasis to one short phrase per paragraph when needed.
Do not emphasize a sequence by styling every stage as a separate card.
Evidence states require text labels and border forms in addition to color.
Avoid decorative uppercase strings except compact Latin running heads and source labels.
prohibitedPatterns: mixed display fonts inside one title
font-size changes used to imply unsupported importance
utility monospace used as body copy
validation: inspect computed font family, size, weight and line height for every semantic role
confirm no opening paragraph uses first-letter enlargement
confirm fallback fonts render all Korean glyphs
confirm every page has selectable text and no overflow
inspect the contact sheet for stable rhythm and abrupt density changes
leave physical print, grayscale and assistive-technology validation pending for an independent validator
